name: Dandelions of the Heart Sangha
address: Boston Center for Contemplative Practice, 11 Kent Street, Brookline, MA 02445
access: Boston Center for Contemplative Practice, 11 Kent Street, Brookline, MA 02445
description: This is a mostly silent sit with a closing dharma reflection except on Thursday and Friday. Feel to drop in and sit for any part of that time.

name: Peaceful Garden Sangha
address: United Parish Church, 210 Harvard Street, Brookline, MA
access: Use the Marion Street entrance (up the stairs to the Parlor on the left). Green C line or Bus 66. Or ample free parking on side streets.
description: We are a community of friends brand new and others with an established practice. We are open to everyone on a walk-in basis. We're peer-led and rotate facilitation. Each evening we share a reading and talk about what comes up for us. Together, we discover the power of being and practicing in community.

name: Peaceful Songbird Sangha
access: For in-person, there's street parking and lot parking behind the temple.
description: We meditate, check-in with one another, share a reading from a teacher of the dharma, and follow with dharma discussion, metta practice and a final meditation. We practice in the Plum Village tradition of Thích Nhất Hạnh, with its emphasis on engaged Buddhism and the art of mindful living. We began meeting at Chua Vietnam, a beautiful Vietnamese temple in Roslindale, MA. We have been practicing online via zoom since March of 2020. Once a month we meet in person, dates depending on the schedule of the temple.All are welcome to join us.

name: Wake Up Boston
access: Conveniently off the red line, with limited metered street parking.
description: A mindfulness meditation community for 18-35-ish year olds practicing in the tradition of Plum Village Buddhism / Zen Master Thích Nhất Hạnh. In a typical evening gathering, we'll enjoy a guided sitting meditation, walking meditation, dharma reading, and dharma sharing about our experiences and practice in everyday life. We welcome people of all backgrounds regardless of faith or meditation experience.

name: Joyful Lotus Sangha
address: Cambridge Zen Center, 199 Auburn Street, Cambridge, MA
access: Conveniently off the red line, with limited metered street parking.
description: The Black, Indigenous and People of Color (BIPOC) Sangha is a monthly gathering of self-identifying BIPOC practitioners that provides a safe place to meditate and explore contemplative practices. This sangha cultivates an environment that welcomes diverse voices and builds community. In a typical practice group, we enjoy a mix of walking meditation, sitting meditation, chanting, readings, and dharma sharing about our experiences and practice in everyday life.

name: Tree House Sangha
description: A morning practice gathering in the Bedford area.

name: Mountain Bell Sangha
description: A Belmont-area sangha with in-person and online practice options.

name: Green Fields Sangha
address: First Parish Church, 4 Bedford Rd, Lincoln, MA

name: Sangha of the Seven Hills
address: Assumption Center, 16 Vineyard St, Worcester, MA
access: Free parking in the lot available.
description: A Worcester sangha in the Plum Village tradition, hosted at Assumption Center. Our format: 20 min sitting, 10 min walking, a short reading, dharma sharing. Welcoming to, new or experienced practitioners. Drop in anytime, no advance notice needed, free to participate.

name: Mindful Lunch
access: Contact the organizer for the Zoom Link.
description: A brief mid-day eating practice for pausing, arriving, and practicing mindfulness during lunch.

name: Peaceful Heart Sangha
access: Contact the organizer for the Zoom Link.
description: We meet weekly over zoom. All are welcome and no previous meditation experience is necessary. We rotate facilitation by volunteer who chooses a reading. We practice sitting, walking and dharma sharing in a welcoming, non judgmental confidential setting.

name: Living the 14 Sangha
access: Contact the organizer for the Zoom Link.
description: The 14 Mindfulness Trainings are the foundation of the Order of Interbeing and we are strengthening our commitment to them by looking deeply at a single training each week. We are open to OI members, OI Aspirants and pre-Aspirants. "Pre-Aspirants" includes anyone who would like to learn more about Thay's teachings. Each week is a study in itself. You are welcome anytime, week to week.

name: Lotus Pond Sangha
access: Contact the organizer for the Zoom Link.
description: We meet every other week on Zoom to practice sitting and walking meditation, followed by dharma sharing. We often read a short text to start dharma sharing to help us gather the mind and open the heart. We welcome everyone.
